recommendation: Conduct comprehensive medication reconciliation and optimization for heart failure patients
implementation_steps: Conduct comprehensive medication reconciliation at transitions of care
Identify and resolve drug-related problems and interactions
Optimize guideline-directed medical therapy (GDMT) in collaboration with the care team
Monitor for drug interactions and adverse effects
Provide patient counseling on medication use, adherence, and potential adverse effects
evidence_summary: Pharmacist-led medication reconciliation and optimization interventions have demonstrated significant improvements in medication appropriateness, adherence, and clinical outcomes in heart failure patients across multiple studies.
citation: Multidisciplinary Strategies for the Management of Heart Failure Patients at High Risk for Admission
